x1_measurement_protocol.scope: GitHub Actions, local real HTTP Python handler and scripted Strands sandbox. No AWS or model network calls; not deployed latency or human benefit.
x1_measurement_protocol.order: Ordinal 1 desktop, 2 mobile, alternating through 20; ten per viewport. One worker, zero retries, no warmups or discarded outliers. Fresh browser context and sandbox per attempt; same running CI processes, not AWS cold-start samples.
x1_measurement_protocol.fixture: One new invented120kg produce offer, Demonstration cooperative, collection2026-09-14, use_by2026-09-18, unknown allergens. Same bytes each attempt. Never historical offer4471.
x1_measurement_protocol.journey: CSV preview and selected filing -> allocation -> exact approval -> Omonoia Soup Kitchen claim -> simulated capacity0 disruption -> replan -> fresh exact approval -> first current share claim, schedule one hour ahead and explicit simulated confirmation -> copy/download plain-text manifest.
x1_measurement_protocol.timing: Monotonic milliseconds. Primary interval begins immediately before file selection and ends when Simulation confirmed is visible, after session/page readiness. Separately record setup, each stage, each HTTP request through completion, and local manifest export. Scripted clicks/waits and instrumentation overhead are included; human think-time is absent. Export is outside primary latency.
x1_measurement_protocol.bounds: 20 planned attempts; each attempt60s maximum including setup/export, one worker, zero retries, continue after failure. Workflow30min ceiling includes installation/build. Infrastructure cancellation may leave NOT_RUN attempts; never claim a complete20-sample result then.
x1_measurement_protocol.failure_policy: Keep every ordinal, status, failing stage, elapsed time and request outcome. Failed/incomplete attempts are not success latency values and are never silently replaced. Report attempted/planned/success/failure/not-run denominators and validity. Missing, duplicate, reordered, nonfinite, negative, reversed or mismatched-identity measurements invalidate the aggregate.
x1_measurement_protocol.statistics: Per viewport and overall, successful primary latencies: n, median, nearest-rank p95, minimum and maximum. Raw20 attempt slots remain available. No speedup, baseline comparison, human time saved, food rescued or cost saving claim.
x1_measurement_protocol.cost: Request counts and UTF-8/body byte counts are traffic proxies, not billed costs or wire bytes. Model network is prohibited by the source harness. AWS/model dollars, Lambda billed duration and beneficiary impact stay NOT_MEASURED; parent alone controls separate AWS measurement and cost limits.
x1_measurement_protocol.identity: Retain protocol-registration commit, measured source SHA, actual protocol content digest, run ID/attempt, environment and viewport, raw JSON plus summary. Registration commit must be an earlier ancestor than measured commit and contain this exact unchanged protocol. Source-only evidence must not enter AWS acceptance receipts.

cases.requirement: Two valid sessions isolate donation state, exact-plan authority and request-ID retries
cases.preconditions: Two newly created valid sandbox sessions A/B in separate browser contexts; source CI uses real HTTP, SQLite and scripted Strands only
steps: File a new invented offer, run and explicitly approve in A; after each step compare B with its initial empty-work snapshot and reload B history
Submit A's exact approval request under B's valid handle; verify A-only offer is absent
Explicit positive control: file a different donation in B at the same session-local offer ID; transplant A approval before and after B's own legitimate run using B's current version
Transplant the full A plan/run/key/digest, mixed foreign run or digest, and pickup claim; verify refusal with unchanged A/B state and no durable save in the Python integration test
Replay A's original run and approval request IDs in A; verify no second write and no change to B; B's own plan still needs fresh consent

Record addresses are workspace-local: matching keys alone grant no authority. A retries return its existing state and never populate B.
cases.negative_recovery_case: An unknown token is a separate expiry-boundary check, not evidence of two-session isolation. A stale or transplanted plan cannot pre-check B's consent or enable its approval button.
